prompt: Origin: rendered in-browser from the original procedural three.js model in apps/web/src/components/cuppy/scene.ts (swirl geometry in swirl.ts, spoon in spoon.ts, strand in strand.ts) and the original rubber-hose face drawn in apps/web/src/components/cuppy/face.ts.
